meaning: Persons a work itself credits: its compiler (owner ruling 2026-11-22: the final compiler is always a transmitter and heads every chain of his work) and a transmitter the work names in full where no source identity stands. A compiler reuses an existing narrator row only where the archive already identifies that person by a standing rule in that tradition (standing mentions counted on production 2026-11-22, see `reuse_basis`); otherwise he gets a work_register row credited to the work. Never merged across traditions. Owner-reviewable data: edit, then rebuild the projection. Rationale: pg_export/AGENTS.md §Compiler as first transmitter.
